About Us

Odeko is the all-in-one operations and technology partner to more than 20,000 independent coffee shops, cafes and other food establishments.

Through the Odeko web portal and mobile app, customers can purchase supplies from hundreds of national and local brands, track ordering trends, finance equipment, and access insurance. Customers that use Odeko can increase their revenue, reduce their environmental footprint, and save significantly on their cost of goods and time spent on vendor management. 

Odeko is on a mission to continuously develop technology to champion your neighborhood cafes, coffee shops, and other independent F&B establishments.

Local coffee shops and cafes are the backbone of any given community, and we’re here to help manage the day-to-day tasks with a platform so intuitive, it’s kinda like magic.

The Odeko team is diverse, passionate, and innovative. Our 400+ employees are spread across numerous departments and business lines, but are single-minded in our mission to develop technology to support the many needs of our customers. We believe that small businesses need support now more than ever, and that Odeko is uniquely positioned to provide that support.

 

As a Buyer, you will manage procurement operations across multiple warehouses, including forecasting, inventory management, purchase order processing, vendor management, and exception handling of third-party service providers. You'll collaborate closely with Operations and Sales teams to drive operational efficiencies and revenue enablement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Procurement Manager to deliver procurement support across warehouses, including: forecasting, demand and supply planning, replenishment execution, and supplier management.
  • Build deep expertise in inventory SKUs and collaborate across the Odeko network to establish and scale best practices
  • Track and continuously improve key performance indicators including fill rate, inventory turnover,  and gross profit margins
  • Foster cross-functional relationships across the warehouse network to ensure alignment on best practices are consistently shared and implemented
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, Finance, and Procurement Operations to understand budgetary targets and develop methods for measuring savings, value creation, and category performance metrics
  • Work internally and with suppliers to develop innovative procurement solutions that support the operations network
  • Design and implement supplier scorecards to drive continuous performance improvement

Required Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in supply chain or procurement operations
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills
  • Demonstrated vendor/supplier relationship management experience
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace Apps, particularly Google Sheets
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, IT, or related field
  • Ability to understand process flows and identify opportunities for cost savings, inventory reduction, or operational improvements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with NetSuite or similar ERP systems
  • Prior procurement or buying experience
  • Highly self-motivated with a customer-centric mindset
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Commitment to delivering exceptional internal and external customer experiences

What you’ll love about Odeko:

  • Fast-paced environment and growth opportunities - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and enhance your career!
  • Competitive compensation, healthcare benefits, and opportunity for equity
  • Other great perks -  Full lists of benefits available upon request

 

Odeko is proud to be a diverse, equitable, and inclusive employer. We encourage all to apply regardless of educational background, race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.
